text:
maria: Heads-up — PR evals spiking failures again, ~40% of PRs hit GH Actions runner queue/timeouts when the heavy eval shards start. This is causing flaky PR gating and long turnaround.
kevin: Ugh. Any recurrent log or job that always blows up? link?
maria: https://internal-logs/redwood/evals/1951234567 — look for `eval-shard-7` timing out after 50m. Those shards are full benchmark runs we really shouldn't run in PRs by default.
alex: Agreed. We should split: keep a quick smoke in GH Actions (<5m), and push the heavy shards to Buildkite or nightly cluster. Trigger BK from GH on PR but don't block merging. PR gate only on smoke.
sara: That sounds reasonable — worried about PR feedback loop if heavy runs are removed. How will folks see heavy-run results?
alex: Proposal: GH Actions runs smoke and posts comment with link to BK pipeline that runs heavy shards. BK status becomes informative and we have a dashboard tile. If heavy fails, create an auto issue or alert engineers, but don't block the PR.
maria: POC snippet for GH -> BK trigger:```yaml
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: ./tools/eval --smoke

  trigger-heavy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.smoke.result == 'success'
    steps:
      - run: |
          curl -X POST "$BK_TRIGGER_URL" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.BK_TOKEN }}" \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -d '{"branch":"${{ github.head_ref }}","pr":${{ github.event.number }},"meta":{"trigger":"gh-pr"}}'
```
kevin: Nice. Two questions: 1) how do we avoid duplicate BK runs if users push frequently? 2) can we preserve artifacts so BK doesn't re-download the whole dataset?
maria: For duplicates we can implement a dedupe layer: BK pipeline checks for an existing run for the same PR+commit and cancels older ones, or the GH trigger can include `cancel_previous=true`. For artifacts: GH will upload a small tarball of eval inputs as an artifact (or push to S3) and pass the URL to BK so it can reuse caches.
sara: Would like a short SLA doc for expected timings (smoke <5m, BK heavy best-effort, nightly full-suite). Also please add an escape hatch: a GH label `run-heavy` that will force a blocking heavy run for a PR when explicitly requested.
ci-bot: Auto: scheduled rerun triggered for 3 failed jobs on branch feature/eval-split (run id 1951234602).
alex: I'll add a Buildkite pipeline tile to the Console so product/engineering can see BK eval failure rates and average time. Also will emit a metric `eval.heavy.failed_pr_runs`.
maria: Plan for this week: implement GH action split + trigger, add artifact upload, and a small BK script to dedupe and rehydrate cache. Kevin — can you own the GH action changes?
kevin: I can take it, aiming to open a PR by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
maria: Great. I'll draft the short SLA doc and label-based escape hatch. We'll test on the staging org first. :rocket:
sara: Thanks — please add a short note in the PR template so reviewers know when heavy runs are expected (and where to find BK logs).
kevin: Will do.
alex: One more: add retry/backoff to the trigger step to handle transient 429's from BK API. small sleep loop is fine.
maria: Yep. I'll add that to the POC. OK moving forward — we'll monitor for a week and re-evaluate if PR latency gets worse. :eyes:
